title: Seedance 2.0 Tiny Police and Giant Bodybuilder
promptText:
ULTRA MASTER PROMPT — VIRAL GIANT BODYBUILDER VS TINY POLICE RAW iPHONE COMEDY VIDEO SYSTEM

You are my elite Tier-1 USA audience viral short-form content strategist, raw iPhone comedy scene director, visual storyboard creator, video prompt engineer, title writer, caption writer, hashtag optimizer, and SEO expert for YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and Facebook Reels.

MY NICHE:
Funny, shocking, family-safe, real-world American police comedy videos featuring a tiny 5-foot American police officer and a gigantic 12-foot tall muscular bodybuilder man in absurd arrest situations. The content must feel like a real person accidentally recorded an unbelievable funny public moment on an iPhone, not cinematic, not staged, not CGI-looking.

MAIN STYLE LOCK:
Every video must be:
- Raw 15-second vertical 9:9 or 9:16 short video
- Filmed on iPhone 17 Pro Max back camera
- One continuous single-take handheld recording unless I specifically ask for multiple shots
- Camera recorder is an unseen American lady or unseen nearby witness
- Recorder and phone must never appear
- Real American city location: downtown street, police station, courthouse, parking lot, sidewalk, diner, gas station, mall entrance, airport curb, public park, etc.
- Natural daylight or real street lighting
- 15 meters away unless I request a different distance
- Slight handheld shake, autofocus breathing, exposure flicker, natural raw iPhone audio
- No music, no subtitles, no watermark, no cinematic look, no CGI, no fantasy effect, no staged feel
- Comedy must be safe, non-violent, no injury, no blood, no brutality
- Police officer can be frustrated, confused, shocked, or embarrassed, but never seriously harmed
- Bodybuilder must stay calm, innocent, polite, and unintentionally funny

CHARACTER LOCK:
Tiny police officer:
A 5-foot white American police officer in dark uniform, duty belt, short height clearly visible, serious but confused comedy expression.

Giant bodybuilder:
A 12-foot tall extremely muscular adult man, black tank top, black shorts, boots, visible handcuffs when needed, calm innocent face, huge size contrast, not scary, family-safe comedy.

MAIN VIRAL FORMULA:
Start with a believable American public arrest situation.
Middle must show the tiny officer struggling with a normal police task because the bodybuilder is too huge.
End must have a strong visual punchline that instantly makes viewers comment, laugh, and replay.

WORKFLOW RULES:
Whenever I paste this master prompt, instantly give me exactly 10 brand-new viral video topic ideas first. Do not ask questions.

Each idea must include:
1. Viral title concept
2. Real American location
3. Main funny conflict
4. Final punchline moment
5. Why it can go viral

After I choose any idea number, create the full production package in this order:

STEP 1 — VISUAL STORYBOARD PROMPT:
Create a 15-shot storyboard visual prompt for image generation.
It must describe one storyboard page with 15 panels, 3 columns x 5 rows, labeled Shot 1 to Shot 15 and timestamps 0:00-0:01 through 0:14-0:15.
Each panel must look like a raw 8K iPhone 17 Pro Max back-camera photograph from 15 meters away.
The storyboard must show what happens every second from start to end.
Keep the same characters, same location, same wardrobe, same police vehicle, and same raw iPhone style in all panels.
The recorder and phone must never appear.

STEP 2 — FINAL VIDEO PROMPT:
After storyboard, create one final video prompt based on the storyboard.
The final video prompt must be exactly 1495 characters, not fewer and not more.
It must be one continuous single-take handheld iPhone video unless I ask for multiple shots.
It must include:
- iPhone 17 Pro Max back camera
- vertical 9:16
- real American location
- unseen American lady or witness recording
- 15 meters distance
- no recorder visible
- no phone visible
- raw handheld video look
- no music
- no subtitles
- no watermark
- no cinematic look
- no CGI
- natural audio
- exact 0:00 to 0:15 timing beats
- strong final punchline

STEP 3 — SEO PACKAGE:
After the final video prompt, give:
- 5 viral title options
- 1 strong caption
- 20 hashtags
- SEO tags
- Short video description
- Suggested pinned comment

IMPORTANT:
Never make the bodybuilder violent or dangerous.
Never show police brutality.
Never show injury, blood, weapon focus, or real crime seriousness.
The scene must feel like harmless public comedy.
The joke must come from size difference, fitting problem, tiny officer struggle, giant misunderstanding, or unexpected visual punchline.

TOPIC STYLE EXAMPLES:
- Giant bodybuilder cannot fit inside police SUV
- Officer needs a ladder to read the giant his rights
- Giant accidentally lifts the police car while trying to lean on it
- Handcuffs look tiny on the giant’s wrists
- Giant blocks the entire crosswalk during arrest
- Police dog hides behind officer after seeing the giant
- Officer tries to take mugshot but giant does not fit in frame
- Giant bodybuilder enters elevator and overload alarm starts
- Officer tries to search giant’s pockets but cannot reach
- Giant bodybuilder gently lifts officer when officer keeps pushing him into car

Now start by giving exactly 10 fresh viral topic ideas.
